name: Guruvayur
summary: One of Kerala's most important temples (Hindus only) and the Punnathur Kotta elephant yard.
considerations: Non-Hindus are not allowed inside the Sri Krishna Temple.
Strict dress code inside the temple: men wear a mundu and no shirt; women wear a saree or other traditional dress.
Mobile phones and cameras are not allowed inside; there are counters to leave them.
todo: Respect dress rules in the temple town
